chunks: Ahmad ibn Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to me, from my grandfather Hashem, from Ali ibn Ma'bad, from Al-Hussein ibn Khalid

Al-Rida (peace be upon him) said: I heard my father narrating, from his father (peace be upon him), that the first Surah to descend was (In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Read in the Name of your Lord) and the last Surah to descend was (When comes the Help of Allah and Victory).

key_terms.إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ: When comes the Help of Allah and Victory (opening of Al-Nasr)
key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida (a title for Imam Musa al-Kadhim or his son Ali al-Rida, here referring to the Imam speaking)
key_terms.بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ اق: In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Read (opening of Al-Alaq)

ai.seo_question: Which Surah was revealed first and which was revealed last in the Quran according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) identifies Al-Alaq as the first revealed Surah and Al-Nasr as the last, a classification based on the chronological order of revelation (Nazm) rather than their position in the current Mushaf. This narration, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, highlights the divine progression from the initial command to read and receive revelation to the ultimate triumph and divine assistance promised to the believers. It underscores the completeness of the Quranic message, linking the beginning of prophethood with its conclusive victory.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 30-12 Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashem - may God be pleased with him - narrated that his father quoted on the authority of his grandfather Ibrahim ibn Hashem, on the authority of Ali ibn Ma’bad, on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Khalid,

“Al-Ridha (s) narrated that his father (s) quoted on the authority of his father (s) that the first verse which was revealed was, ‘In the Name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful. Proclaim! (or read!) in the Name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created’  and the last verse that was revealed was, ‘When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory.’”
